parameters.content:
META PORTAL SYNC

1. Select the saved Press Burger Meta/Facebook Graph API credential on all four Meta HTTP Request nodes.
2. Run manually and confirm the resolved ad account.
3. Validate daily, campaign, and lifetime-ad row counts.
4. Activate only after the manual execution succeeds.

The workflow backfills 14 completed days for attribution lag and refreshes lifetime ad totals.

PURCHASE METRICS

Online orders and revenue use one purchase action by priority to avoid double counting overlapping Meta action rows:

1. offsite_conversion.fb_pixel_purchase
2. onsite_web_purchase
3. web_in_store_purchase
4. omni_purchase
5. purchase

Leads and other actions are intentionally excluded. Clicks use inline_link_clicks when available, otherwise clicks.
